implementation: Caller-owned ordinary full-APK sessions with fresh host consent for every commit
Verified immutable unique APK snapshots reuse Installer signature/split/update checks
Bounded FileBridge protocol over a server-only Windows duplex named pipe

limits: No actual Google Play catalog download/install has been demonstrated
Real session success uses host shell authority; an attached application caller trial is still separate
No personal profile, account, credentials, Google requests, APK application code execution, or normal-install update

Installer source attribution remains unknown; no fake Play-origin metadata

Final independent QA and integration on the updated main baseline remain parent tasks
